name: posh
description: A luxuriously simple and powerful way to make front-ends with DataScript and Reagent in Clojure.

paragraphs: Posh is a ClojureScript / React library that lets you use a single DataScript database to store your app state. Components access the data they need to render by calling DataScript queries with q or pull and are only updated when the query changes. transact! is used within components to change the global state. If you are familiar with Datomic, you will find Posh incredibly easy to use. If not, it's worth learning because of the power and versatility it will give your components.

Posh is now self-contained and can be used with multiple front-ends (see posh.core), such as Reagent, Rum, or Quiescent. Only Reagent is currently well-supported by Posh, and is the focus of this documentation.

posh.reagent uses Reagent and can be integrated with your current Reagent project. Because it uses a single database to store app state, like Om or re-frame, it is fitting to write large, extensible apps and reusable components, with the added benefit of being much simpler to use and having a more expressive data retrieval and state updating syntax.
